All surfaces remain WHITE; doors and windows are outlines, never black fills. No solid shadows, broad grey shading, hatching, texture, pencil grain, gradient, color or gold. Sparse graceful contour rendering; roof planes white, not striped by every tile; brick walls untextured white; brackets shown selectively as small clear outlines. Confirm 9 eaves, not 8, 10 or 13.
